name: Cornflakes mixture
ingredients_raw: Cornflakes (26%), Refined Palmolein Oil, Potato (8%), Bengal Gram Flour (Besan) (8%), Cashew Nuts (7%), Raisins (7%), Refined Sugar, Spinach, Iodised Salt, Fennel Seed, Cumin, Curry Leaves, Red Chilli Powder, Black Salt, Black Pepper, Dried Ginger Powder, Clove, Cardamom, Cinnamon, Nutmeg, Bay Leaves, Acidity Regulator (INS 330) & Asafoetida. CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL COLOUR PAPRIKA OLEORESINS (INS 160c)
